scope: Public browser renderer: End/typing beside a trailing inline atom
cause: An empty text wrapper after an uneditable inline atom lacked a native line endpoint; Chromium End moved to a later root paragraph.
repair: Reuse the view-only caret placeholder after a final inline atom; simplify the equivalent all-empty-runs check. No model character or hard break is added.
checks: Native click, End and typing remain in the original paragraph
Following paragraph and note body stay intact
No additional model hard break or visual line is introduced
limits: Three desktop engines and these atom fixtures; not a full mobile/IME or every custom NodeView matrix.
